流畅的工作流程 LTX

LTX 工作流程是一些疯狂的意大利面，不是吗？通过这个工作流程，我尝试将 UI 简化为基础，同时保持与流畅工作流程 v4.0 一体机对于广域网 2.2。

展示中使用的所有图像都使用相同的洛拉、权重和配置集。唯一的区别是用于 I2V 的图像以及 Img2Vid 和 Txt2Vid 代的肯定提示。

因此，在我们开始之前，展示上的所有视频都使用以下内容：

型号->ltx-2.3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_scaled

劳拉->ltx-2.3-22b-蒸馏-lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_105_bf16

文本编码器 ->gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled

文本编码器 ->ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16

VAE->vae/LTX23_audio_vae_bf16

VAE->vae/LTX23_video_vae_bf16

VAE->taeltx2_3

升级器 -> ltx-2.3-空间放大器-x2-1.1（更新）

劳拉->SmoothMix 动画 LTX - v1.0

当然，您应该使用您的硬件可以处理的模型/loras/编码器的设置以及您自己的偏好。 ^^

下载所有必要的内容后，请确保安装并更新了这些扩展：

Comfyui-自适应提示

舒适山地车

rg三舒适)

ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite

ComfyUI-KJNodes

ComfyUI-易于使用

舒适UI-GGUF（如果您使用 GGUF 模型）

ComfyUI-mx工具包

  • 初始设置

选择您的工作流程：Image2Video 或 Text2Video。

在工作流程的中间，您可以设置您这一代将使用的所有模型和 Loras。

如果您要使用 GGUF 模型，请记住将 GGUF 节点连接到 Lora 节点。

使用 LTX 时，您可以做出非常具体的积极提示。检查展示柜中的示例。默认的否定提示对于大多数情况来说应该足够了 - 如果需要，可以删除或添加提示。

设置您希望视频的长度。默认设置为 10 秒。

  • IMG2VID 和 TXT2VID 工作流程

两个工作流程都遵循相同的格式。设置音频和视频的分辨率和帧速率。默认情况下，它设置为 25 帧，这是 LTX 默认设置。有些人也尝试将其设置为30帧，效果不错，所以也尝试一下。

没有什么可以尝试的，因为任何小的改变都会产生巨大的差异：种子/噪声、采样器（默认设置欧拉）和 CFG 都可以随时用于新值。因此，如果需要，请更改其中任何一个。

但对于模式高级用户来说，其他所有内容的组织方式如下：

  1. 有四个子图：图像设置, 采样器1, 采样器2和解码。每个都有一组非常简单、易于理解的节点。它应该可以让您轻松找到或更改您认为必要的内容。

  2. 图像设置有一个非常简单的升级。这样可以使生成速度快。在此处更改升级方法。

  3. 采样器1和采样器2拥有可以更改 ManualSigmas 的采样器。工作流程在其上有不同的默认 ManualSigmas采样器1。两个工作流程都有相同的默认 ManualSigmas采样器2。确保将其更改为您的首选值。

  4. 解码有最终的解码器。它使用所有标准解码器。非常简单。如果您有首选的 VAE 解码器，只需在此处更改即可。

SMOOTH WORKFLOW LTX

LTX Workflows are some crazy spagetti aren't they? With this workflow I tried to simplify the UI to the basics while keeping the same UI setup as theSmooth Workflow v4.0 AIOfor WAN 2.2.

All images used on the Showcase use the same set of loras, weights and configurations.The only difference are the images used for I2V and Positive Prompts for the Img2Vid and Txt2Vid generations.

So, before we begin, all videos on showcase used the following:

Model ->ltx-2.3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_scaled

Lora ->ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_105_bf16

Text Encoder ->gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled

Text Encoder ->ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16

VAE ->vae/LTX23_audio_vae_bf16

VAE ->vae/LTX23_video_vae_bf16

VAE ->taeltx2_3

Upscaler -> ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1(update)

Lora->SmoothMix Animation LTX - v1.0

Of course you should use the setup of models/loras/encoders that your hardware can handle and your own preferences. ^^

After downloading all thats necessary make sure to these extensions installed and updated:

Comfyui-Adaptive Prompts

Comfy-mtb

rgthree-comfy)

ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite

ComfyUI-KJNodes

ComfyUI-Easy-Use

ComfyUI-GGUF(In case you use a GGUF model)

ComfyUI-mxToolkit

  • Inital Setup

Choose your workflow: Image2Video or Text2Video.

In the middle of the workflow you set all the Models and Loras your generation will use.

If you are going to use a GGUF Model remember to connect the GGUF Node to the Lora Node.

You can make very specific Positive Prompts when using LTX. Check the showcase for examples. The default Negative Prompt should be enough for most cases - if necessary delete or add prompts to it.

Set how long you want your video to be. Its set to 10 seconds by default.

  • IMG2VID and TXT2VID WORKFLOW

Both workflows follow the same format. Set the resolution and the frame rates for the Audio and Video. Its set to 25 frames by default as thats the LTX default setting. Some people also try setting it to 30 frames with good results, so give it a try as well.

There isn't much else to try since any small change can make a huge difference: The Seed/Noise, the Sampler (euler is set by default) and CFG are readily available for new values. So change any of them if needed.

But for mode advanced users here is how everything else its organized:

  1. There are four Subgraphs:Image Setup, Sampler 1, Sampler 2andDecode. Each has a very simple, easy to follow, set of nodes. It should make it easy to find or change what you think its necessary.

  2. Image Setuphas a very simple upscaling. Its like this to make generation fast. Make changes to upscaling methods here.

  3. Sampler 1andSampler 2have the samplers where you can change the ManualSigmas.The workflows have different default ManualSigmas on theirSampler 1. Both workflows have the same default ManualSigmas on theirSampler 2. Make sure to change it to your preferred values.

  4. Decodehas the final decoder. It uses all the standard decoders. Very Simple. If use have a prefered VAE decoder just change it here.
